verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document native delivery of control-failure or drift alerts to Slack, email, or ticketing tools. Vanta documents webhooks for real-time event notifications, but the evidence does not confirm they cover test failures. They also act as a developer building block that requires a custom receiver to reach where the admin works. Marketing claims of continuous monitoring and AI that "flags gaps" describe in-platform behavior, not alert routing with fix context.
